source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7, code 06E and Worksheet for Code 06E, Lines 1 to 6; FAQ page 1, Annual Retirement Income Exclusion (R.S. 47:44.1(A)); Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 30,000.00 + IRA distribution (person 1) 5,000.00 + taxable interest 20,000.00 = 55,000.00. Federal taxable income = 55,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 20,300.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 2 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Worksheet for Code 06E (both columns): Line 1(a) 30,000.00 (person 0, age 66); Line 2(a) 0.00; Line 3(a) = 30,000.00; Line 4 12,000.00; Line 5(a) lesser of Lines 3 and 4 = 12,000.00. Line 1(b) 5,000.00 (person 1, age 68); Line 2(b) 0.00; Line 3(b) = 5,000.00; Line 4 12,000.00; Line 5(b) lesser of Lines 3 and 4 = 5,000.00. Line 6 adds Lines 5(a) and 5(b) = 17,000.00, code 06E. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 55,000.00. Line 3 total = 55,000.00. Exempt income: code 06E 17,000.00. Line 4H = 17,000.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 55,000.00 - 17,000.00 = 38,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 38,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 2) 25,000.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 38,000.00 - 25,000.00 = 13,000.00. Line 11 = 13,000.00 x .03 = 390.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 390.00. Person 1's unused 7,000.00 of room does not pass to person 0, whose excess 18,000.00 stays taxable.
